summary.headline: Predictions for the Fire Triplicity
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the fire triplicity—Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius—cover marital discord, immorality, disease, war, rainfall, hail, fires, drought, plagues, deaths, and the fortunes of rulers and soldiers, with additional outcomes when Mars or Venus is ascendant. Specific omens concern Khuzestan, Ahvaz, Arab Iraq, the Hejaz, and Babylonia.
